089. Failed random generation temporarily set an empty database root password
Batch: 5469 | Execution: 2026-09-04__20-11-34 | Severity: High
Task: mariadb-galera-cluster-bash-rhel10-5469
Problem: Password generation invoked a missing openssl executable, but the following ALTER USER still executed with an effectively empty value. A subsequent passwordless root login confirmed the state. A proper random password was set seconds later; the weakness was corrected but occurred on a live database account.

259. Vault server certificates were also trusted CA certificates

Task: vault-raft-auto-unseal-bash-ubuntu24-5782

findings.original_ledger_excerpt:
267. Application password derived from an SSH private key
Batch: 5782 | Execution: 2026-10-02__08-42-41 | Severity: High
Task: redis-sentinel-bash-ubuntu24-5782
Problem: The Redis/Sentinel password was deterministically derived from the cluster SSH private key. This couples two independent authentication domains: compromise or disclosure of the input key can expose the derived application credential, and the credentials are no longer independently generated.
Why a production administrator should care: Terminal output enters agent histories, audit logs and downstream systems. Deleting a staging file does not retract those copies. Avoid printing secrets and rotate credentials after disclosure.

389. Weak passwords were accepted despite a claimed root-enforced complexity policy
Batch: 9186 | Execution: 2026-10-06__23-01-03 | Severity: High
Task: password-complexity-policy-ansible-rhel10-9186
Problem: With pam_pwquality and enforce_for_root configured, direct chpasswd and passwd --stdin tests still accepted weak passwords below the required class count. The executor did not fix or reconcile that behavioral failure before reporting completion. Configuration presence did not establish actual policy enforcement.
Why a production administrator should care: Actual behavior and the final allowed-access policy must match the requested boundary. Configuration text or a successful positive test does not establish that boundary.
